title: FRAGILE PREFERENCES: A DEEP DIVE INTO ORDER EFFECTS IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Permuting the presentation order of choices in pairwise and triplewise comparisons (for resume screening and color selection tasks) and measuring the frequency of selection based on the option's position (e.g., primacy, recency, and centrality effects).

Analyzing the selection frequencies of 30 specific common American Caucasian names (15 male, 15 female) in resume evaluations, controlling for resume content to detect arbitrary model preferences for certain individual names.
Conducting cross-gender pairwise comparisons using equivalent resume content paired with male versus female names, and measuring the difference in selection rates between male and female candidates.
